'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is shot dead by an [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settler]] near a farm in [[Karnei Shomron]], in the [[West Bank]]. **[[Angola]] announces that it will deploy [[Angolan Army|troops]] to the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], following the failure of a [[ceasefire]] between [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|government forces]] and [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] in [[North Kivu]]. '''Arts and culture'''
*[[Prince Edward, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Edward]] is named as the new [[Duke of Edinburgh]] by King [[Charles III]]. The title was previously held by his father, [[Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Philip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-64913224 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[March 2023 United States bank failures]]
**[[Collapse of Silicon Valley Bank]]
***American [[commercial bank]] [[Silicon Valley Bank]] is forcibly shut down by regulators for the [[U.S. state]] of [[California]], and its assets controlled by the [[Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation]], after the bank failed to raise enough [[financial capital|capital]] and a subsequent [[bank run]] occurred. With assets totalling [[United States dollar|US$]]209 billion, the bank's closure is the [[List of largest U.S. bank failures|second-largest bank failure in American history]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/03/10/investing/svb-bank/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/silicon-valley-bank-collapses-fdic-b2298381.html (''The Independent'')]
